## How the files were produced
- Facts and figures: a read-only script recomputed every number from repository JSON/CSV/joblib/source files into a fact sheet and drew all data figures from it (matplotlib).
- Report: one content source rendered to PDF (ReportLab), DOCX (python-docx) and Markdown, so all three carry identical text and numbers.
- Presentation: python-pptx, reproducing the Review-I deck's slide size (10 × 7.5 in), logo placement, Times New Roman titles, footer bars and colours (#ED800B, #BD582C, #E2EFDA, #FCE4D6).
- QC: an independent checker re-read raw repository files and confirmed each reported number appears in the report and (for headline numbers) the slides.
- Build scripts and intermediate files were kept in the session scratchpad, not in the repository.
